verdict.rationale: Penpot documents extensive API/plugin/MCP access (objects and properties, webhooks, access tokens, plugin system) suggesting broad programmatic control, but there's no explicit claim or evidence of full UI/API parity, and probes for an OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s, indicating the API surface isn't fully discoverable or documented as complete. missing for 10: explicit statement of full UI-API feature parity, a public OpenAPI/schema reference, and independent (community/hands-on) confirmation that all UI actions are scriptable via API.
